knimeNode.name: Elitism
knimeNode.shortDescription: Selects which parents and children remain in the population.

fullDescription.intro: Automatically reads objectives, directions, constraints, the initial population size, NFE, and the evaluation budget from Problem Setup. Provides standard elitism, parent-child DE competition, NSGA-II, NSGA-III, and GDE3 survivor selection. Population size can remain fixed or decrease linearly with NFE for L-SHADE.
